changes.title: Custom boss health
changes.text: Boss health now follows its own locked setting instead of ordinary enemy health.

changes.title: Boss phase protection
changes.text: Custom boss health preserves Yog's phase boundaries and Dwarf King's shield objectives, including fractional remainders across saves.

changes.title: Custom food supply
changes.text: Food supply follows the selected percentage;25%provides a standard ration in each region and100%retains original generation.

changes.title: Boss and food regressions
changes.text: Added boss-phase/save and regional-food checks, and included minimum food in the combined custom-generation fixture.

changes.title: Narrow warning access
changes.text: Added a scrolled narrow-screen capture to check access to the experimental warning's scoring paragraph.

changes.title: Verification and investigation records
changes.text: Recorded verified warning checks, custom boss/food evidence and the unconfirmed upstream audio report.

changes.title: Developer Commentary
changes.text: I added boss health and regional food settings while protecting boss progression. Offensive damage attribution, healing, equipment supply and permanent statistics integration still need work.
